commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: Even when a task is fit to do, think out the means of finishing it before you start, because saying you will start now and think later is a fault. The means are four: gifts, sweet words, division and punishment. Start without thinking these through and the enemy blocks the work, it can’t be dropped halfway, and the ruler suffers.
